annotations.note: Mail was sometimes lost when ships or planes carrying it went down.
Army units in the Solomons staged shows, and touring USO troupes visited the larger bases.
A rare luxury at forward bases, and a famous morale booster. Small ships had no ice-cream machines.
Good timing: the Post Office asked families to mail Christmas gifts for men overseas between Sept. 15 and Oct. 15 so they would arrive in time. A pair of slippers came in a package on Dec. 6.
